mobility_database: Mobility Database refresh token (https://mobilitydatabase.org, account, then 'refresh token'); env MOBILITY_DATABASE_REFRESH_TOKEN
transitland: Transitland API key (https://www.transit.land, account, API key); env TRANSITLAND_API_KEY
nap_es: Spain NAP API key (https://nap.transportes.gob.es, register); env NAP_API_KEY
ntd: optional Socrata app token (https://data.transportation.gov); env SOCRATA_APP_TOKEN
